versions.changelog: Display name: the card showed the title-cased slug; the publisher name is now XH Agents x402, matching the name on xhagents.xyz, and the artifact declares it too. No code change.

Payer accepts the documented x402 v1 network shorthand ("base") as an alias for eip155:8453, which is what most v1 sellers advertise - buyers no longer need to normalise it by hand. Authorization is still built for eip155:8453 only; unknown shorthands are still refused. Also: package carries no build artefacts.
first release: paid x402 data for agents (trust scoring, token safety, wallet/market intel) with a quote-first payer script
